authority: User approved plan, requested canonical internal IDs, waived old alpha compatibility, and instructed implementation
supersedes: Earlier requirements to preserve old question IDs and legacy alpha progress/link compatibility, for this new app only

requirements.identity: All curriculum internal and visible question IDs match ^[A-Z]{2,3}-[A-Z0-9]{6}$. Canonical IDs throughout providers, responses, marking, history, persistence and links. Olympiad exempt.
requirements.codes: Retain compliant IDs; promote existing review codes; fixed permanent collision-checked mappings. Acid-base reversible base36 six-character configuration/seed encoding with bounded seed space using existing codec approach, not truncation/hashing. Same canonical code reproduces same question.
requirements.alpha: Fresh versioned alpha data namespace; old test storage untouched and unused; no old-code migration or obsolete-code compatibility required. Preserve raw original source references as provenance.
requirements.fidelity: Reuse original final component DOM/CSS/fonts/SVGs and interactions for electron configuration, reaction profiles, pH curves, typed/numeric answers, written correction, self-review and feedback. Preserve educational distinctions. Scoped React components, not legacy page wrappers.
requirements.chrome: Keep accepted common masthead, pink code only at top, grade/level pill, footer and invisible timing. No restored redundant headings/timers/pause controls.
requirements.stats: Single shared original A Level bar-chart SVG component used identically by both courses.
requirements.boundaries: Only apps/Masters-of-Chemistry implementation/artifacts plus authorized swarm log/archive. Original siblings and their stores untouched. Existing shared assessment engine retains first-score/timing ownership. No Rocket, new activities, deployment or backend. Olympiad remains outside mastery. Preserve accepted dot-cross and molecule editor experience.

delegation.retry: One clarified bounded retry, then root escalation; no silent model substitution

stages.title: Identity and representative UI foundation
workers: Original reference matrix and typed-answer/correction pilot
stages.foreman: Shared interfaces and Stats icon; validation; no F2 dispatch until root accepts

stages.gate: Root source and rendered review before independent acceptance

workers: Independent canonical identity, UI and learning-flow review

acceptance: Fresh data namespace, no writes/reads of old test storage
Practice/revision/teacher restoration, first evidence, invisible timing and no correction duplicate evidence
Relevant chemistry/marking regression, typecheck, both builds and release budget checks
Original hashes or known offline metadata unchanged; prior evidence preserved
Final original-source and shared-code diff review plus actual rendered inspection
